MAC RELEASE

Mac 1.5.16 · build 32

See expected departure and remaining time together in your chosen menu bar format.

Previous Mac release2026-10-19
Mac DMGMac ZIP

macOS 13 or later · Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel

HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

Fixes the menu bar ignoring your remaining-time format and showing only expected departure. It now shows the departure time alongside the countdown in your chosen unit.

For example, arrive at 09:00 and expect to leave at 18:00. At 16:29:30, minutes mode shows Leave 18:00 · 91 min left. The expected departure time stays the same.

Improvements

  • Changing milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours or hours/minutes in Settings → General updates the menu bar immediately.
  • Remaining time refreshes every second, or every 0.1 seconds in milliseconds mode. After expected departure, the menu bar shows only the expected departure time.
  • Waiting for arrival, Day off today and Leave day labels, existing attendance and preferences are preserved.

Support and limits

macOS 13 or later; Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel. This fix applies to the Mac menu bar. The latest public Windows release remains 1.5.13 and is unchanged by this Mac update.

Keeps the today panel, arrival editing, workday modes, plugins and appearance settings from 1.5.15. The app identifier and record location stay the same; updating does not require deleting your records.

The countdown uses your saved arrival and configured work/break durations. It does not create an actual departure record or approve overtime or meal payments.

Uses a fixed self-signed certificate and Sparkle update signatures. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not applied. Other Macs, physical Intel hardware and actual unlock/reboot login remain separate validation scopes.

Downloads

Open the DMG and move HappyLulu to Applications, or extract the ZIP and move the app. Quit the existing app before replacing it.
